item.description: OpenAI is reopening its $200 Pro subscription to new sign-ups but cutting API credits per dollar in half. The move is part of OpenAI's shift from subsidized flat-rate plans toward usage-based billing.

item.description: For decades, CPG software recorded the work but never did it, says Confido Cofounder and CEO Justin Hunter. Closing that gap between logging a problem and actually fixing it is what convinced 250+ CPG brands, from Dude Wipes to Unilever, to run their back office through Confido. The company just closed a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners, bringing total funding to $77M, on the back of 5x year-over-year growth.
